opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award

amount.raw: The Conference Attendance Award will cover registration for the conference(s) applied for and attendance at the meeting dinner(s) as detailed above. The member can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application. The recipient will then receive a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation, up to the total value of the award, on presentation of receipts for costs incurred.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligibility for the Conference Attendance Award is detailed above – the value of the award and the frequency with which the members can apply changes with membership category. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants for the Conference Attendance Award must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Conference Attendance Awards are intended primarily for the support of member engagement at our own meetings but where funding allows will also support attendance at Society‐sponsored events.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award

amount.raw: The Institutional Engagement Award cannot be paid direct to an individual/personal account. Successful applicants will arrange for their institution to issue an invoice to the Society, for the payment of funds.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Applications must be received by the deadlines laid out above. Applications not received in this timeframe will not be considered. Applications will only be considered if their events take place after the application window closes.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund

amount.raw: Funds should be used within 12 months of the date of receipt, supporting the activity outlined in the application.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should demonstrate how this fund would enhance their commitment to physiology and benefit the wider community of physiologists.
opportunities.summary: Our Unlocking Futures Fund is open to postdoctoral researchers who require an additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
